key_provisioning.format: 32-byte Ed25519 seed supplied by operator only after concrete review; no generation/import command in this CLI
key_provisioning.purpose: existing trustchain.cowork.handoff-stop-ack.v1 only; never acceptance.check or performer request signing
key_provisioning.public_pin: must equal observer.public_key and differ from existing request_key_id; include in exact Platform observer admission

prerequisites: Root-owned isolated Python interpreter and dependencies; invoke fixed qa_handoff_cli.py with -I -B; no writable PYTHONPATH or caller flags.
Install the five exact files from installation.prepared.json; retain unchanged StopObserver and StateDirectory from the candidate. No general Studio UI runs as root.

Create a NEW disposable active work item and normal bilateral exact agreement. qa_native_cli.py uses real ExactContractManager.confirm_for_delivery and AgentRunManager/RunStore to allocate the actual apr before root admission; no fabricated binding/run or parallel allocator.

Precreate one runsc container with pinned image/argv/environment, no network, UID1000, readonly rootfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, private namespaces, memory/PID limits and only the exact QA workspace mount.
Provision a dedicated persistent cgroup-v2 parent for this single run; verify the actual Docker cgroup parent and boot identity. Never substitute a broad system.slice or an existing personal sandbox.

Create root admission.json with exact scope, one actual binding_id and one actual apr_id, precreated container identity, host/workspace and observer public pin. No retrospective attachment to old runs.

After startup registration and an ordinary owner handoff request, retain the exact current authenticated native query as tcwh_<id>.authority.json under the protected state directory. Its request has exactly request_id/request_hash/scope/binding_ids/expected_run_ids, plus server acknowledgement_hash in the closed wrapper.

Public observer admission in Platform must match the same request key, binding/run inventory, program digest, host/workspace and expiry; default-disabled candidate routers/guards require separate reviewed deployment.

An enrolled performer transports the CLI-generated ACK through the existing native /handoff/ack route. Owner complete creates a new backlog work item; the successor obtains its own current contract, consents and execution admission.

compatibility.observer: subclass of the actual apatch_studio.work_handoff_stop.StopObserver, adding early exact admission validation; original ACK construction/persistence/retry logic unchanged
compatibility.candidate_transport: existing WorkHandoffDelivery/native query+ack; no parallel server protocol

limits: Local engine/kernel tests do not prove real Linux/gVisor containment. A fresh real positive and negative server exercise is still required.
No historical macOS execution, accepted v6 artifact, or general uncontained Studio command is covered.
Unexpected registration interruption, host reboot, cgroup replacement, escaped tracked PID, container restart or state drift fails closed; this adapter has no reset/unfence/reconcile command.

Root provisions the request from current authenticated native authority. This offline CLI does not fetch or invent server requests; only the existing server decides ACK admission and handoff completion.
native_lifecycle: qa_native_cli.py / qa_native_lifecycle.py; public normal runner schemas unchanged; README contains exact invocation and root steps
